body: Investigators have recovered three pieces of a Learjet 60's left elevator between 1.3 and 3.8 miles from the road where the jet crashed in Palm Beach County, Florida, on November 1, 2026, killing both pilots and all seven passengers. The pieces account for most of the left elevator, and National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB) member Tom Chapman said at a November 3 briefing that their discovery confirms part of the tail separated in flight.

Chapman said the crew would have been unable to pull the Learjet out of its dive without the elevator intact. "At those speeds I don't know that it would've been effective even if it had still been attached to the aircraft," he said. Still frames from dashcam footage taken moments before impact appear to show the Learjet missing its entire horizontal stabilizer; whether the whole stabilizer separated remains a focus of the investigation. The NTSB has not determined when the elevator separated, or whether losing it contributed to the loss of control.

Aurora Aviation operated the charter flight from Austin-Bergstrom International Airport in Texas to North Eleuthera in the Bahamas. At about 12:47 local time, the Learjet was flying at 35,000 feet when the crew reported light clear icing and moderate turbulence, describing the ice as manageable but telling air traffic control the jet was deviating from its assigned altitude by about 700 feet. The crew then reported precipitation and asked to climb to 37,000 feet; less than 30 seconds after a controller approved the climb, the crew radioed that the aircraft was descending and declared an emergency. At about 12:48, the crew reported an overspeed, and the jet struck South Military Trail near Greenacres about three minutes later.

The nine people killed were Austin tech entrepreneur Adam Robinson, 45, and his wife, Helen Sharp, 40, their two young children, the children's nanny, Ana María Ramírez Cetina, 24, and family friends Rowan Charmi Fehr Toews and Rachael Reed, both 38. The pilots were Captain Jeffrey Gregory, 55, and First Officer Nathalia Gadelha Filgueiras, 20. Crews had to pump water from the impact crater before investigators could reach the main wreckage, after a water main broke and heavy rain slowed the work. Maintenance records showed a cockpit voice recorder had been installed, although investigators were still working to establish whether it was aboard for the flight. The NTSB has received dashcam footage and multiple eyewitness accounts, and the investigation is still in its early stages, with no probable cause identified.
en.summary: The NTSB says most of the Learjet 60's left elevator was found 1.3 to 3.8 miles from the Florida crash site, confirming part of the tail separated in flight; all nine people aboard were killed and the cause is still under investigation.
en.title: Investigators find pieces of Learjet's elevator miles from Florida crash site

body: 美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）委員查普曼在11月3日的簡報中表示，調查人員在佛羅里達州棕櫚灘郡墜機地點外1.3至3.8英里處，尋獲Learjet60左升降舵的三塊殘骸，合計約為左升降舵的大部分，證實機尾部件在撞擊地面前已於空中分離。該機11月1日墜毀於格林埃克斯附近的南軍事步道一帶，機上2名機組員與7名乘客全數罹難。

查普曼指出，沒有升降舵，機組員無法將飛機拉出俯衝；他說：「At those speeds I don't know that it would've been effective even if it had still been attached to the aircraft.」行車紀錄器撞擊前瞬間的靜止畫面顯示，飛機似乎已失去整個水平尾翼；調查人員先前在11月2日的簡報中已表示有空中解體的跡證，整個水平尾翼是否分離仍是調查重點。NTSB尚未判定升降舵何時分離，也未判定升降舵脫落是否導致失控，或是飛機下墜過程中的作用力造成部件脫落。
這架包機由Aurora Aviation營運，原定由德州奧斯汀柏格斯壯國際機場飛往巴哈馬北伊柳塞拉。當地時間約12時47分，飛機在35,000呎高度通報輕微晴空結冰與中度亂流，機組員稱結冰尚可應付，但飛機已偏離指定高度約700呎；隨後機組員通報降水並要求爬升至37,000呎，管制員批准不到30秒後，機組員即通報飛機下降並宣布緊急狀態，約12時48分通報超速，約3分鐘後墜毀。

罹難的9人包括奧斯汀科技創業家Adam Robinson（45歲）與妻子Helen Sharp（40歲）、兩名年幼子女、子女的保母Ana María Ramírez Cetina（24歲），以及家庭友人Rowan Charmi Fehr Toews與Rachael Reed（皆38歲）；機組員為機長Jeffrey Gregory（55歲）與副機長Nathalia Gadelha Filgueiras（20歲）。撞擊坑積水使調查人員一度無法接近主要殘骸，現場水管破裂加上大雨拖慢了作業；維修紀錄顯示機上曾安裝駕駛艙語音紀錄器，但調查人員仍在確認該次飛行是否搭載。NTSB已取得行車紀錄器畫面與多名目擊者說法，調查仍在初期階段，尚未認定可能原因。
zh.summary: NTSB表示，佛羅里達Learjet60左升降舵大部分殘骸在墜機地點1.3至3.8英里外尋獲，證實機尾部件在撞擊前已於空中分離；機上9人全數罹難，事故原因仍在調查中。
zh.title: 調查人員在佛羅里達墜機現場數英里外發現Learjet升降舵殘骸
